{{Quote|According to the Alliance main computer, Brother Vrovel is an eccentric Bith who has helped the Rebels on numerous occasions. He himself is not a pilot... for that matter, he has almost no pilots in his ranks.|[[V3-FX]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Brother Vrovel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a pilot in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Vortex Squadron]], stationed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
